findings.title: Vercel production security environment is incomplete
findings.evidence: Production variable names do not include ENVIRONMENT, COOKIE_SECURE, or CORS_ORIGINS; missing ENVIRONMENT selects development defaults and cookie_secure=false.
findings.action: Set production environment, secure cookies and explicit production CORS; verify secret length without disclosing values.

findings.action: Include migration in reviewed release and verify/apply it through the approved production migration process before serving schema-dependent code.

findings.title: AI rate limiting is process-local
findings.evidence: Configured request limiter is not shared across serverless instances/workers.

findings.evidence: SDK defaults to a 600-second timeout and two retries; no application override or verified Vercel duration was found.
findings.action: Validate production duration and configure an explicit timeout/retry budget if needed.
